result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor content issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated at the right edge of the screen with no visual indication of scrollability (no scroll indicator or partial reveal cue).
issues.suggestion: Add a visible partial card peek or a horizontal scroll indicator to communicate that the list is scrollable. Ensure the card text is not clipped abruptly without an ellipsis.

issues.description: The last visible restaurant card at the bottom of the screen shows a '-0%' badge, which is semantically meaningless and likely a placeholder or data error (a 0% discount badge serves no purpose).
issues.suggestion: Remove the discount badge entirely when the discount value is 0%, or ensure the backend only sends a badge when there is a valid non-zero discount to display.
